verdict.rationale: Langfuse is a platform rather than an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. First-party docs list an official MCP Server for connecting AI tools that cannot run shell commands, and a Docs MCP page lets Cursor or other coding agents connect and integrate Langfuse tracing. A probe also confirms the official MCP server is documented. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP server's tool set, auth and setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect an AI tool that cannot run shell commands | MCP Server
Use Cursor (or other AI Coding Agent) to automatically integrate Langfuse Tracing into your codebase
official MCP server documented at https://langfuse.com/docs/docs-mcp
